name: Cornerless Minimum Equals the Dismantlable-Ample Obstruction Minimum
statement: The least order $c_{\min}$ of a nonempty cornerless ample class equals the least order $m_{\mathrm{amp}}$ of an ample forbidden pc-minor for the dismantlable ample classes. More precisely, every such forbidden pc-minor contains a nonempty cornerless ample subclass, and every nonempty cornerless ample class has such a forbidden pc-minor of order at most its own.
proof: Starting from an ample forbidden pc-minor, repeatedly delete corners. Corner deletion preserves ampleness, and the process cannot empty the class because that would be a corner peeling; it therefore ends in a nonempty cornerless ample subclass. Conversely, a cornerless ample class is not dismantlable. Choose a smallest pc-minor of it that is still not dismantlable. Every proper pc-minor has fewer vertices and is dismantlable by minimality, while ample pc-minor closure keeps the chosen class ample, so it is a forbidden pc-minor of no larger order.
